I now have the complete picture. `POST /api/owners` is handled by `OwnerRestControllerV1.addOwner` (V1; the V2 controller only exposes a paged list). Here is the full ordered pipeline.

## `POST /api/owners` — ordered pipeline

Legend: **[V]** = validation (throws → 4xx via the exception advice), **[S]** = side-effect / mutation.

### A. Entry — `addOwner` (`OwnerRestControllerV1:146`)
1. **[V] Authorization** — `@PreAuthorize("hasRole(@roles.OWNER_ADMIN)")`; caller must hold the `OWNER_ADMIN` role.
2. **[S] Read `Idempotency-Key` header** (`idempotencyKey()`) — trimmed; blank/absent → treated as none.
3. **[V/short-circuit] Idempotent replay** (`replayIdempotentCreate`) — if that key already produced an owner that still exists, return **200 OK** with the original owner and stop (no new owner, none of the steps below run).

### B. Effective registration date — `effectiveRegistrationDate` (`:623`)
4. **[V] Future-date check** — a supplied `registrationDate` after today → `InvalidFieldsException` (400, field `registrationDate`).
5. **[S] Default + business-day roll** — use supplied date else `now()`, then `toBusinessDay` rolls Saturdays/Sundays/listed 2026 public holidays forward to the next business day. This adjusted date is what everything downstream uses.

### C. Intake rules — `prepareNewOwner` (`:556`), in this exact order
6. **[S] Address normalization** (`applyAddress`) — prefers structured `addressLine1`/`addressLine2` (normalized, and flat `address` recomposed from them); otherwise normalizes the flat `address`. Normalization trims, collapses whitespace, upper-cases, and expands `ST→STREET`, `RD→ROAD`, `AVE→AVENUE`. Runs *before* the required-field check so a blank-after-normalization address is caught.
7. **[V] Required fields** (`validateRequiredFields`) — `firstName`, `lastName`, `address`, `city`, `telephone` must be non-blank → `RequiredFieldsMissingException` (400, `errors` array of all offenders).
8. **[V/S] Telephone normalization** (`normalizeTelephone`) — strips spaces/dashes/brackets, forms E.164 (assumes `+61` and drops a leading `0` when no `+`), requires `+` followed by 8–15 digits, then `validateNationalNumberLength` enforces per-country length (`+61`→9, `+1`→10). Invalid → `InvalidFieldsException` (400, `telephone`). Stored normalized in place.
9. **[V/S] Email normalization** (`normalizeEmail`) — optional (`null` allowed); if present must match the email pattern and its domain must not be on the disposable blocklist (`mailinator.com`, `tempmail.com`, `guerrillamail.com`); stored lower-cased. Invalid/disposable → `InvalidFieldsException` (400, `email`).
10. **[V] Postcode** (`validatePostcode`) — optional; if present must be exactly 4 digits, and if the city maps to a known region (NSW 2000–2099, VIC 3000–3099, QLD 4000–4099) must fall in that range → else `InvalidFieldsException` (400, `postcode`).
11. **[V] Hard duplicate identity** (`rejectDuplicateIdentity`) — unless `sharesHousehold=true`, computes the identity key (SHA-256 over normalized telephone + canonical email + Soundex of last name); if any non-deleted owner already has it → `DuplicateIdentityException` (409).
12. **[V] City capacity** (`rejectCityAtCapacity`) — if the city (case-insensitive) already holds ≥ 50 owners → `CityCapacityExceededException` (409).
13. **[V] Daily limit** (`rejectDailyLimitExceeded`) — if ≥ 100 owners already carry the adjusted registration date → `DailyOwnerLimitExceededException` (429).

### D. Build & derive the entity — `createOwner` (`:216`)
14. **[S] Map DTO → `Owner`** (`ownerMapper.toOwner`).
15. **[S] Set `registrationDate`** to the adjusted business-day date.
16. **[S] Derive `memberId`** (`memberIdFor`) — `<REGION><FY><HASH8><LuhnCheck>`, then de-duplicated against existing member ids (`-2`, `-3`, …).
17. **[S] Set `namesakeCount`** — count of pre-existing owners sharing first+last name (case-insensitive).
18. **[S] Assign `householdId`** (`assignHousehold`) — SHA-256-derived from `(lastName, postcode, V2 tag)`; `null` when no postcode.
19. **[S] Set soft-duplicate flags** (`applyPossibleDuplicate`) — sets `possibleDuplicate`/`possibleDuplicateOf`; skipped when `sharesHousehold`; matches on Soundex(lastName)+postcode with a differing identity key.
20. **[S] Set `membershipLevelCap`** (`householdMembershipLevelCap`) — one above the max membership level of existing non-deleted household members, else `null`.

### E. Persist & post-persist side-effects
21. **[S] `clinicService.saveOwner(owner)`** — persists; owner gets its generated id.
22. **[S] Stamp `householdMemberCount`** (`applyHouseholdMemberCount`) — now includes the just-saved owner.
23. **[S] Human-readable audit line** (`auditOwnerCreated`) — `AUDIT` logger: id, memberId, registrationDate, membershipLevel.
24. **[S] Structured `OWNER_CREATED` event** (`emitOwnerCreatedEvent`) — increments the shared `OWNER_CREATED_SEQ` and emits schema-v2 JSON (seq, schemaVersion, ownerId, memberId, membershipLevel, ownerSegment, event) to `AUDIT`.
25. **[S] Welcome notification** (`enqueueWelcomeNotification`) — `NOTIFY` logger: id, memberId.

### F. Response assembly — back in `addOwner` → `createdOwnerResponse` (`:365`)
26. **[S] Record idempotency mapping** — if a key was supplied, store `key → owner.id` in the shared `IDEMPOTENT_CREATES` map.
27. **[S] Build 201 Created** — maps to `OwnerDto` and derives read-time fields `bulkSignupWarning` (> 80 owners that day), `capacityWarning` (city holds 40–49), and `riskFlag` (soft-duplicate OR disposable-adjacent email OR city capacity warning); attaches a `Location: /api/owners/{id}` header.

A couple of things worth flagging: the daily-limit, city-capacity, namesake, duplicate, and member-id-dedup checks each call `clinicService.findAllOwners()` and scan in memory (not DB queries), and several validation limits (100/day, 50/city) and the idempotency/sequence state are held in **static** in-memory fields shared across all requests — so despite the "standard Spring conventions" framing in CLAUDE.md, this create path is heavily customized rather than a plain CRUD insert.
